items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: When I used to play the carnival ball with Tornel Luop, I used to read all the violin parts to reinforce the violin sections.

ctx.x: Yeah. I hate to tell you, but you sound pretty good.

You know, it was a good band. I like tenor. I cut my teeth on alto, but I could never really control an alto. I never felt like I had an alto saxophone under control. It was an instrument of the devil, you know. But tenor, I got along very well with tenor. And I had enough musical background. In fact, at that time when tenor began, the tenor bands became very popular, I had no problem reading the alto parts, which is a transposition. As a matter of fact, I thank God I never had any trouble with any transposition.…
Who was in that band with Sharpie, huh? When you recorded? Do you remember any of those?
